say:1:1721602001:0.text: Commander, did everything go well in the upper district?
say:1:1721602001:0.source_cn: 司令，您回来了。上城区的护卫任务还顺利吗？

say:2:1721602002:0.text: I escorted Prince Orion back to the palace and reinforced patrols in the area. Isn't today your day off?
say:2:1721602002:0.source_cn: 王子殿下已安全返回王宫。我也加强了那边的巡防。我记得你...

say:3:1721602003:0.text: ... Father, please allow me to assist in the investigation into the Hall of Ancients case.
say:3:1721602003:0.source_cn: ……父亲，我想跟你谈谈圣古堂和佩吉的失踪案，我请求参与调查！

say:4:1721602004:2.text: Didn't I already make myself clear? Magister Merlin and I will handle this case. Stay out of it.
say:4:1721602004:2.source_cn: 我记得我在王宫里已经说得很清楚了，这件事由我和梅林阁下...
say:4:1721602004:2.male: Didn't I already make myself clear? Magister Merlin and I will handle this case. Stay out of it.
say:4:1721602004:2.female: Didn't I already make myself clear? Magister Merlin and I will handle this case. Stay out of it.

say:5:1721602005:0.text: You are to remain here and oversee daily operations. Do my orders mean nothing to you now?
say:5:1721602005:0.source_cn: 你的任务是待在驻地，处理日常治安事件。怎么？我的命令现...

say:6:1721602006:0.text: I don't understand! Father, as captain of the First Division, I have a duty to act when a member of the royal family goes missing!
say:6:1721602006:0.source_cn: 这不合理！父亲，我是守备军第一分队的队长，王室成员失踪...

say:7:1721602007:0.text: Besides, Peggy is also my friend!
say:7:1721602007:0.source_cn: 更何况，佩吉不仅仅是公主，她还是我的朋友！

say:8:1721602008:0.text: As captain, I expect you to follow orders.
say:8:1721602008:0.source_cn: 正因为你是队长，你才更要服从命令。

say:9:1721602009:2.text: An entire chapel vanished before everyone's eyes... Do you understand what that implies? The power and politics at play are on another level. This is beyond you!
say:9:1721602009:2.source_cn: 能够让整座圣古堂在所有人面前消失……这背后牵扯的势力、...

say:10:1721602010:0.text: Then I'll face it! It's my duty!
say:10:1721602010:0.source_cn: 那又如何？！守备军的职责不就是面对威胁吗？

say:11:1721602011:0.text: Are we meant to cower simply because our enemy might be powerful or dangerous?
say:11:1721602011:0.source_cn: 难道因为敌人可能强大、危险或者手段诡异，我们就能躲起来吗？

say:12:1721602012:0.text: Why do you always doubt me...
say:12:1721602012:0.source_cn: 为什么……您总是不肯相信我是有能力的……？

say:13:1721602013:2.text: Because bravery and talent alone won't stand against a plot of this magnitude! As long as I remain commander, I won't allow you to join the investigation.
say:13:1721602013:2.source_cn: 因为你的勇敢或者能力在阴谋面前一文不值！只要我还是守备...

say:14:1721602014:0.text: You should go home, Captain Gwyneth!
say:14:1721602014:0.source_cn: 你可以回家了，格温妮丝队长！

say:15:1721602015:0.text: ... Yes, Commander. I'll do my best to be the "obedient" daughter you want.
say:15:1721602015:0.source_cn: ……遵命，司令阁下。如您所愿，我会努力做一个“听话”的女儿。

say:0:1721603001:0.text: ... *Sigh* I can't stay here any longer.

say:1:1721603002:0.text: Let me get some air at the plaza.

say:1:1721604001:1.text: That's the stall that sells Secret Pals Boxes.
say:1:1721604001:1.source_cn: 那里是，萌友宝盒的摊位。

say:2:1721604002:1.text: I'm getting one to blow off some steam!
say:2:1721604002:1.source_cn: 去抽抽看吧，就当是花钱消气了！

say:1:1721605001:1.text: Impressive, Gwyneth! With skill and luck like that, it's no surprise you're a captain!
say:1:1721605001:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝小姐，你太厉害了！这实力和运气，不愧是守备军的队长！

say:2:1721605002:1.text: Ha, today isn't all that bad after all! At least with these boxes, I get what I pay for.
say:2:1721605002:1.source_cn: 看来，我今天遇见的也不全是坏事。至少在宝盒这里，付出就...

say:3:1721605003:1.text: You have the ability and the luck to back it up! You'll succeed at anything you do!
say:3:1721605003:1.source_cn: 那是当然！像您这样既有魄力又有运气的人，无论做什么肯定...

say:4:1721605004:1.text: Here's your prize. Come again soon!
say:4:1721605004:1.source_cn: 记得拿好您的“战利品”，欢迎下次光临哟！

say:0:1721606001:0.text: That really lifted my mood. I'm ready to get back to work now.
say:0:1721606001:0.source_cn: 好受了很多，可以回驻地继续工作了。

say:0:1721607001:1.text: You guys are free to hang out with Allo!
say:0:1721607001:1.source_cn: 你们几个可以陪艾尔了！

say:1:1721607002:0.text: Hurron, is this the Royal Guard base or a playground?
say:1:1721607002:0.source_cn: 呼伦，这还是守备军驻地吗？

say:2:1721607003:0.text: I thought I'd wandered into a noblewoman's bedroom!
say:2:1721607003:0.source_cn: 我还以为是哪个贵族小姐的卧室！

say:5:1721607004:1.text: Haha! Well, she really is a noblewoman, Hurron.
say:5:1721607004:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈！呼伦，你别这么说。毕竟人家可是正牌的贵族小姐。

say:6:1721607005:1.text: The archery training is brutal. We can't blame her for wanting to have some fun, right?
say:6:1721607005:1.source_cn: 摆弄弓箭的日子太苦了，肯定得玩点童趣的东西找找安慰嘛。

say:7:1721607006:1.text: A plush toy? Aren't those for toddlers?
say:7:1721607006:1.source_cn: 安慰玩偶嘛？这种软趴趴的东西，三岁小孩才玩吧？

say:8:1721607007:1.text: I'm off duty now. Keep your nose out of my personal belongings.
say:8:1721607007:1.source_cn: 现在是自由活动时间。我的私人物品与你们无关。

say:9:1721607008:1.text: If you're not tired enough, I can add another two sets of weighted runs for you.
say:9:1721607008:1.source_cn: 如果太闲，我不介意让你们加两组负重跑。

say:10:1721607009:2.text: Come on, Captain Gwyneth, relax a little. We just think the toy doesn't quite belong here.
say:10:1721607009:2.source_cn: 别这么严肃嘛，格温妮丝队长。我们只是觉得……这东西和守...

say:11:1721607010:1.source_cn: 毕竟您是守备军，是战士。真正的军人，应该像我们一样强壮...

say:12:1721607011:1.text: That's not a very soldierly thing to do, I'm afraid.
say:12:1721607011:1.source_cn: 你这样子，可没有一点守备军的模样！

say:13:1721607012:1.text: Soldierly? You mean I should mask my incompetence with rudeness, like you, to count as a proper guard?
say:13:1721607012:1.source_cn: 守备军的模样？你是说，像你们这样满嘴偏见、只会用粗鲁来...

say:14:1721607013:2.text: How dare you! Being captain doesn't mean you can say whatever you like!
say:14:1721607013:2.source_cn: 你——！说谁无能？！别以为你是队长我们就怕你！

say:15:1721607014:1.text: You only got promoted because of your father! Don't think you're better than the rest of us!
say:15:1721607014:1.source_cn: 你不就是靠着你父亲才坐上这个位置的吗？还敢教训我们什么...

say:16:1721607015:1.text: If you're so good, why not prove it to us? Or are you too busy babying your little toy?
say:16:1721607015:1.source_cn: 既然队长这么自信，不如让我们见识一下？还是说，您怕弄坏...

say:17:1721607016:1.text: Very well. I'll show you what it really means to be a guard. Come at me together.
say:17:1721607016:1.source_cn: 很好。既然你们对守备军这个词有这么大的误解，那我就免费...

say:18:1721607017:1.text: You asked for this! Don't blame us for ganging up on you!
say:18:1721607017:1.source_cn: 这可是你自找的！别怪我们以多欺少！

say:1:1721609001:0.text: See how wrong you were? If you can't even beat me, what gives you the right to judge me?
say:1:1721609001:0.source_cn: 看来，你们的标准出了点问题。连我这个玩玩偶的人都打不过...

say:2:1721609002:0.text: Th-This is impossible... You were supposed to be...
say:2:1721609002:0.source_cn: 这……这不可能……你明明是个……

say:3:1721609003:0.text: Listen! There's no one way to be a guard! So long as you protect those in your charge and win the battles you must, you are a guard.
say:3:1721609003:0.source_cn: 听好了！守备军没有标准的模样，只要能守护该守护的人，只...

say:4:1721609004:0.text: Anyone else got something to say?!

say:7:1721609007:0.text: Rules are rules—losing to me means 20 laps of weighted runs tomorrow morning.
say:7:1721609007:0.source_cn: 既然输了，就按规矩办。明早负重跑20圈。

say:11:1721609010:0.text: Guyse and Hurron limp away together, leaving Gwyneth alone on the training grounds.
say:11:1721609010:0.source_cn: 盖伊和呼伦相互搀扶着狼狈离开，训练场又只剩下的格温妮丝。

say:12:1721609011:1.text: (Guyse and Hurron were harsh, but they did remind me... I'm a noble lady.)
say:12:1721609011:1.source_cn: （虽说盖伊和呼伦说的话并不好听，不过正牌的贵族小姐么…...

say:13:1721609012:1.text: (Father forbade me from investigating as a guard, but... he can't stop me from inviting a few noble ladies to tea, can he?)
say:13:1721609012:1.source_cn: （父亲禁止我以守备军的身份介入调查，但是……他可没办法...

say:14:1721609013:1.text: (In Savannah, real secrets are exchanged over tea.)
say:14:1721609013:1.source_cn: （赛凡纳有些情报是流通在会议桌之上，可还有更多更隐秘的...

narration:15:1721609014:1.text: Gwyneth strides toward her office, where she prepares some writing paper, picks up her quill, and composes several invitations...

narration:16:1721609015:1.text:
"Dear Resa, it's been a while...
Dear Lady Karena, I've heard much about your expertise in the latest courtly fashion trends...
Catherine, I have some updates regarding the matter we discussed last time...
Would you be free to join me at Sofia's Teahouse tomorrow afternoon?"
narration:16:1721609015:1.male:
"Dear Resa, it's been a while...
Dear Lady Karena, I've heard much about your expertise in the latest courtly fashion trends...
Catherine, I have some updates regarding the matter we discussed last time...
Would you be free to join me at Sofia's Teahouse tomorrow afternoon?"
narration:16:1721609015:1.female:
"Dear Resa, it's been a while...
Dear Lady Karena, I've heard much about your expertise in the latest courtly fashion trends...
Catherine, I have some updates regarding the matter we discussed last time...
Would you be free to join me at Sofia's Teahouse tomorrow afternoon?"

say:0:1721610001:0.text: It's time to attend the gathering in the upper district.
say:0:1721610001:0.source_cn: 约定的时间到了，可以出发去上城区了。

say:1:1721611001:1.text: Gwyneth, I never thought you'd invite us out! We haven't seen much of you since you became a Royal Guard captain.
say:1:1721611001:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝！真没想到你会主动约我们！自从你当了守备军的队...

say:2:1721611002:1.text: The flower exhibition—you skipped that, too. At this point, you're the hardest person to see in Savannah.
say:2:1721611002:1.source_cn: 上次的花卉鉴赏你也没来，大家都说你现在可是赛凡纳最难请...

say:3:1721611003:2.text: My apologies, Catherine. I've missed everyone, but my duties have taken up most of my time...
say:3:1721611003:2.source_cn: 抱歉，凯瑟琳，我也很想念大家。只是，军务确实繁重……

say:4:1721611004:1.text: Hmph, your duties. Honestly, dear, I don't see why you'd trade being a noble lady for running around with a bunch of men...
say:4:1721611004:1.source_cn: 哼，军务。亲爱的，我真是不明白，你放着好好的贵族小姐不...

say:5:1721611005:1.text: My father says the base is filthy and reeks of sweat. Let me see your hands... they've gotten rough, haven't they?
say:5:1721611005:1.source_cn: 我父亲说，守备军驻地又脏又乱，全是汗臭味。你看看你的手...

say:6:1721611006:1.text: Yes, you've made a name for yourself as a guard, but it hardly does your reputation as a lady any good.
say:6:1721611006:1.source_cn: 现在的风头虽然盛，但这对淑女的名声可没什么好处。

say:8:1721611007:3.text: Karena... honestly, I think Gwyneth looks cool in armor!
say:8:1721611007:3.source_cn: 卡罗琳……其实、其实我觉得格温妮丝现在穿铠甲的样子很帅气！

say:9:1721611008:0.text: Maybe, but no duke would want a wife like that.
say:9:1721611008:0.source_cn: 那又如何？将来又有哪位公爵愿意娶一个这样的妻子？

say:10:1721611009:1.text: Well, it's my choice. Anyway, Savannah hasn't been exactly peaceful lately. Have you heard anything about what happened to the Hall of Ancients?
say:10:1721611009:1.source_cn: 个人的选择罢了。说起来，最近王都不太平。圣古堂的事情，...

say:11:1721611010:1.text: The ladies' eyes light up at the mention of the subject, and they all lean in closer.
say:11:1721611010:1.source_cn: 听到这个话题，三个女孩的表情瞬间变得精彩起来，纷纷凑近...

say:13:1721611011:2.text: Of course! Dura above, a building that large just vanished without a trace! How unthinkable!
say:13:1721611011:2.source_cn: 当然听说了！艾雅在上，那么大一座教堂……居然凭空消失了...

say:14:1721611012:2.text: My father said the matter was fishy. There were no signs at all beforehand...
say:14:1721611012:2.source_cn: 我听我父亲说，这事儿透着古怪。因为这件事没有任何的预兆……

say:15:1721611013:1.text: Many suspect it was a plan by the <style="highlight">Queen and Princess Peggy</style> that backfired.

say:16:1721611014:1.text: The Queen? What does it have to do with Her Majesty?
say:16:1721611014:1.source_cn: 王后陛下？这和她有什么关系？

say:17:1721611015:1.text: That's the inside story you don't know. You see, Princess Peggy is the Queen's only child, and with the King gravely ill, Her Majesty now rules the empire in his stead.
say:17:1721611015:1.source_cn: 这就是你不知道的内幕了。毕竟佩吉公主是王后陛下唯一的孩...

say:18:1721611016:1.text: So, people are saying the Queen staged the whole thing to boost Princess Peggy's standing for her future reign.
say:18:1721611016:1.source_cn: 大家都猜，是王后想趁着庆典为佩吉公主造造势，好提升公主...

say:19:1721611017:1.text: But in the end, Her Highness failed to draw the sword and ended up trapped in the chapel...
say:19:1721611017:1.source_cn: 结果剑没拔出来，人还陷进去了。真是……

say:20:1721611018:1.text: Karena, be careful what you say. Baseless accusations like that are disrespectful to the Queen.
say:20:1721611018:1.source_cn: 卡罗琳，慎言。这种毫无根据的指控是对王后陛下的不敬。

say:21:1721611019:1.text: Oh please... I'm only repeating what I've heard from others. It's what everyone's been saying...
say:21:1721611019:1.source_cn: 哎呀……我也只是转述别人的猜测嘛，干嘛这么凶。反正大家...

say:22:1721611020:1.text: Don't get upset, alright? We know you're close to Princess Peggy. Let's drop it.
say:22:1721611020:1.source_cn: 是啊是啊，别生气嘛。我们知道你跟佩吉公主关系好，不说这个了！

say:23:1721611021:1.text: Frankly speaking, while the situation with Princess Peggy is regrettable, she's only a princess. What really matters is that <style="highlight">Prince Orion</style> is still fine.
say:23:1721611021:1.source_cn: 不过说实话，虽然佩吉出事很遗憾，但也就是少了一个公主而...

say:24:1721611022:1.text: The future of the Lightbearer Empire rests on his shoulders. As long as he stands, nothing will go wrong.
say:24:1721611022:1.source_cn: 耀光帝国的未来可是系在王子殿下身上的，只要他还在，耀光...

say:25:1721611023:1.text: I agree! Dura above, Prince Orion is the very embodiment of perfection!
say:25:1721611023:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这倒是真的。奥利安殿下简直是完美的化身！

say:26:1721611024:1.text: Have any of you been to a royal hunt? Prince Orion looks so charming on horseback! And I hear he's quite well-read and very gentle...
say:26:1721611024:1.source_cn: 你们之前参加过行猎吗？殿下骑马的英姿简直迷死人了！而且...

say:27:1721611025:0.text: Have you heard? They're already arranging the consort ceremony for His Highness.
say:27:1721611025:0.source_cn: 我倒是听说……这次庆典之后不久，就要开始为王子选妃了！

say:28:1721611026:1.text: I'd better order a few new gowns, just in case I get to attend the ball!
say:28:1721611026:1.source_cn: 我得赶紧去订做几套新礼服，万一有机会参加舞会呢！

say:30:1721611028:1.text: Ladies, I'm afraid I must take my leave. There's an urgent defense plan that requires my confirmation. Let's call it a day.
say:30:1721611028:1.source_cn: 各位，非常抱歉。我突然想起来驻地里还有一份紧急的布防图...

say:31:1721611029:1.text: So soon? I haven't even finished my cake yet!
say:31:1721611029:1.source_cn: 诶？这就走了吗？蛋糕还没吃完呢！

say:32:1721611030:1.text: Please, go on without me. I'll take care of the bill.
say:32:1721611030:1.source_cn: 你们慢用。账单算在我头上。

say:0:1721612001:0.text: This isn't working. I should head back to the base.
say:0:1721612001:0.source_cn: 看来这个办法行不通，先回驻地吧。

say:1:1721613001:1.text: Captain! There's a matter that needs your attention!

say:3:1721613003:1.text: Captain! Commander Hendrik's adjutant asked me to hand this to you!
say:3:1721613003:1.source_cn: 队长！这是司令的副官送来的，指名要亲手交给您！

say:5:1721613004:0.text: Gwyneth opens the envelope and pulls out a scented invitation. The paper is of exquisite quality, its header adorned with elegant cursive script: <style="highlight">Silken Snare</style>.
say:5:1721613004:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝打开信封，抽出了一张散发着香薰味道的邀请函。邀...

say:7:1721613005:1.text: Silken Snare? That's a high-end restaurant in the upper district, notoriously hard to get a table. Father's never been fond of such flashy places.
say:7:1721613005:1.source_cn: 丝绒陷阱？这可是上城区很难预约的高级餐厅，父亲从来不喜...

say:8:1721613006:1.text: According to the adjutant, the Commander booked this place himself. He's expecting you for dinner tomorrow.
say:8:1721613006:1.source_cn: 副官大人说了，这是司令特意订的位置！说是明天诚邀您一同就餐。

say:9:1721613007:1.text: Heh, Captain! Looks like the Commander's trying to patch things up with you! After all, tomorrow is... um...
say:9:1721613007:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，队长，看来司令大人是想跟您和好了！毕竟那天……咳咳……

say:10:1721613008:1.text: Is he planning to apologize? Or... is he finally ready to tell me some of the truth?
say:10:1721613008:1.source_cn: 他是想道歉吗？还是……终于打算告诉我一些真相了？

say:11:1721613009:1.text: Martin, check the roster for tomorrow. Do I have any assignments?
say:11:1721613009:1.source_cn: 马丁，确认一下明天的排班表。我有任务吗？

say:12:1721613010:1.text: Already checked, Captain! You're free tomorrow!
say:12:1721613010:1.source_cn: 早查过了！明天您轮休！您就放心地去赴约吧！

say:13:1721613011:1.text: ... Alright, I'll go. At the very least, I'll hear what he has to say.
say:13:1721613011:1.source_cn: ……好吧，我会去的，至少，先听听他想说什么。

narration:0:1721614001:1.text: While Gwyneth hopes to mend things with her father tomorrow, Merlin sets out for Vina Cemetery in search of the Solitaries.
narration:0:1721614001:1.male: While Gwyneth hopes to mend things with her father tomorrow, Merlin sets out for Vina Cemetery in search of the Solitaries.
narration:0:1721614001:1.female: While Gwyneth hopes to mend things with her father tomorrow, Merlin sets out for Vina Cemetery in search of the Solitaries.
